# github-metrics

> github-metrics is a dynamic, high-performance GitHub profile README generator that renders real-time GitHub activity, contribution streaks, LeetCode, Codeforces, and CodeChef statistics, achievement trophies, top languages, and custom domain insights into a unified, responsive SVG card.

**Original project:** [samdev-pulse](https://github.com/SamXop123/samdev-pulse) by SamXop123. github-metrics is a derivative work based on it; the original copyright notice is preserved in the LICENSE file.

## Documentation & Endpoints

- [Full LLM Documentation](./llms-full.txt): Complete API query parameters, theme references, and markdown examples.
- [Live Generator & Preview](./#studio): Interactive web studio to customize and preview profile cards.

## Quick Usage

Render a standard profile card in Markdown:
```markdown
![github-metrics](https://your-domain.com/api/profile?username=vsmutok)
```

The default theme is `github-dark`. Override it and add LeetCode stats:
```markdown
![github-metrics](https://your-domain.com/api/profile?username=vsmutok&theme=github-light&leetcode=YOUR_LEETCODE_USERNAME)
```
